feeds.title: Craft Passions
feeds.description: Free crochet/kniting/sewing all craft related projects ,free patterns posted daily on this blog .

feeds.title: Emma Varnam's Blog
feeds.description: For nearly ten years I have had a successful crochet and knitting design career. I enjoy balancing my daily need to be creative with sharing my experiences and inspiration on this blog. I have designed both knitting and crochet designs for magazines including; Knitting Magazine, Debbie Bliss Magazine, Let's Get Crafting, Simply Crochet, Inside Crochet and Crochet Now.

feeds.title: Keep Calm and Crochet On U.K
feeds.description: I'm the owner of Keep Calm and Crochet On UK; a happily married, full time working mum with two beautiful little girls.

feeds.title: Catherine Crochets Blog
feeds.description: I started designing my own patterns in 2019, developing a passion for color work, and tapestry crochet in particular. My designs are for blankets, cushions, and other home décor items, as well as accessories such as shawls, scarves, and hats. Read the blog for tips for better crochet, specializing in tapestry crochet blankets.

feeds.title: Dora Does Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Dora Does, where crochet meets mindful, intentional living. This blog includes crochet tips and tricks, free & downloadable patterns blended with articles about mental wellbeing, happy living, personal growth & how to be your best you!

feeds.title: Janie Crow Blog
feeds.description: We aspire to give knitters and crocheters a range of exciting project designs and products which are not available elsewhere. Designer Jane Crowfoot specialises in designs for the home interior - including cushions and throws and regularly teaches workshops to pass on her passion for the crafts of knit and crochet.

feeds.title: Linda's Craftycorner
feeds.description: Hello and welcome. I am a mum of 4 grown up children and I live in the North East of England. I am hooked on crochet and love all things crafty, please come in and make yourself at home.

feeds.title: The Twisted Yarn: Knitting, Crochet, Running, Silliness.
feeds.description: Knitting and crochet blogging at thetwistedyarn.com. I'm also a columnist for Simply Knitting magazine, and a clinical psychologist.

feeds.title: Planet Penny
feeds.description: Crafts, Needle Felting, Crochet, Patterns & Tutorials.

feeds.title: The Pulled Stitch Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I live in Hereford with my two dogs, Suliman the Magnificent and Slim Shady, Oh and my partner Nick. Although I've been to art school I've never studied textiles and a few years ago Nick's Mum, Nan Jan taught me to crochet a Granny Square. Since then I've never looked back.

feeds.title: sewhappycreative Blog
feeds.description: Custom Crochet, Handmade in the U.K with love

feeds.title: Exquisite Crochet UK
feeds.description: Follow Exquisite Crochet UK to get a colourful world of crochet patterns, stitches and tips.

feeds.title: The Mercerie
feeds.description: Beautiful and contemporary Knitting and Crochet patterns, textile courses, and inspiration for crafters. Follow the blog to know more.

feeds.title: HanJan Crochet Blog
feeds.description: Creative crochet patterns with a twist. Designs that blend tradition with fresh, fun ideas. Lucky enough to be a Simply Crochet Magazine designer.

feeds.title: Suz Place
feeds.description: A blog about crochet, colour with lots of free patterns. Run by Susan Pinner.

feeds.title: Annaboo's house
feeds.description: A blog about all things crochet, yarn and even some knitting. You can find lots of my free patterns, tutorials and links to my shop.

feeds.title: Cherry Heart
feeds.description: A craft blog about a Mummy who loves to crochet, knit, quilt, sew, weave and occasionally bake. Includes crochet tutorials and patterns. Run by Sandra.

feeds.title: LucyRavenscar
feeds.description: I'm a crochet pattern designer who loves creating cute amigurumi animals, and creatures and characters inspired by my geeky interests.

feeds.title: Annie's Place

feeds.title: The Woolly Adventures of a Knitting Kitty
feeds.description: Welcome to my creative corner of the world! Make yourself comfy, get your knitting or crochet out and join me for some woolly adventures!

feeds.title: The Patchwork Heart
feeds.description: Crochet artist - Sharing to encourage and inspire you

feeds.title: Little Dove Designs - Little Dove Crochet Blogs
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Faye Walsh and I'm the designer behind all the cross stitch samplers you see here on the website. I also hand make all the crochet items.

feeds.title: What Katie Crocheted
feeds.description: A crochet blog filled with projects, yarn and lessons learnt along the way.

feeds.title: Amigurumi Barmy
feeds.description: Amigurumi barmy is Liz Ward crochet designs. This is where I share all my crafting adventures with the world.

feeds.title: Woolly Chic Designs Blog
feeds.description: Woolly Chic sells beautiful British wool for your next crochet or knitting project. Make something chic and unique with our crochet and knitting kits.

feeds.title: The Little Room of Rachell
feeds.description: I started my blog as a way to keep an online journal of my progress, enthusiasm and to connect with others. It's evolved into a blog showing the things I create, cook and grow and places I visit; including craft shops and events, mostly here in England.

feeds.title: Lottie & Albert Blog
feeds.description: Lottie & Albert the blog - follow along for crochet and craft makes, tutorials and inspiration.

feeds.title: Bunny Mummy
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. I'm Jacquie, a fifty something mum of three growing boys. I work part time and love many crafts, particularly crochet, sewing and drawing.

feeds.title: Great Balls of Wool
feeds.description: I have been knitting on and off for 50 years and I recently learned to crochet. I love looking for wool bargains and making them into something useful. I mainly knit for charity. I occasionally knit for myself and family members if I find a really good pattern or if they ask nicely!!

feeds.title: Pink Milk
feeds.description: Hello. It's so lovely to see you. My name is Heather. I'm in my mid-40s and a single mother of two teenagers. This is my very own corner of the internet where I can drape as much crocheted bunting as I please.

feeds.title: A Kingfisher Morning
feeds.description: Mad knitter and writer Juliet Bernard share her latest adventures in Knitting and creating picturesque crochet designs. Follow A Kingfisher Morning to catch up with her new projects, design ideas, personal updates, and more.

feeds.title: Attic24
feeds.description: Hello! Thank you so much for visiting me in the Attic, it's lovely to see you. My name is Lucy and I'm a happily married Mum with three children. We live in a cosy terraced house on the edge of the Yorkshire Dales in England which we are slowly renovating and making home. I have a passion for crochet and colour and love to share my creative journey.

feeds.title: Moji-Moji Design
feeds.description: I'm Janine Holmes, the owner and designer behind Moji-Moji Design. I specialize in amigurumi crochet. I love the organic way of designing in this media with just a hook, a ball of yarn and my imagination.

feeds.title: Bella Coco Crochet
feeds.description: Bella Coco Crochet is a website to help you learn to crochet. Bringing you fantastic tutorials for crochet for beginners. Find amazing free crochet patterns.

feeds.title: The Wool Nest Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lynne Rowe and I'm a knit and crochet fanatic. I can't imagine a day without picking up my needles or hook and creating something fab and funky. I design for many UK knitting magazines and publications, including Let's Knit, Let's Get Crafting, Knit Today, Inside Crochet, Woman's Weekly and Homemaker. I also teach knit and crochet locally in Cheshire.

feeds.title: The Jellybean Junction Blog
feeds.description: I had tried to master knitting a few times but failed and didn't really enjoy it but I knew that crochet was easier to master and only used one hook.

feeds.title: Plutonium Muffins - A healthy source of fibre!
feeds.description: Plutonium Muffins is all about craft, colour and embracing life. Mainly knitting/spinning and a bit of crochet - but bits of other stuff creep in sometimes. We like penguins, cats and rabbits here!
